```{r setup, warning = FALSE}
#The following code was not written by myself but taken from my data science class. Credit to Scott Appleby.
required_packages <-function(...) { 
  libs<-unlist(list(...)) 
  req<-suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE)))) 
  need<-libs[req==FALSE] 
  if(length(need)>0){ 
    install.packages(need, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org") 
    lapply(need, library, character.only=TRUE) 
  }
  else{message("No packages required installation.")} 
}

required_packages("tidyverse", "readxl", "lme4", "lmerTest", "emmeans")
```

```{r filter}
VPD_All <- VPD_All_Inported |> 
  #Removed only because it was removed from the other data set (an is likely sunned off)
  filter(!(Campus == "CSULB" & Site == "Off" & DateTime >= mdy_hms("03-05-2025 12:30:00") & DateTime <= mdy_hms("03-05-2025 18:00:00")),
         !(Campus == "CSULB" & Site == "Off" & DateTime >= mdy_hms("03-06-2025 13:00:00") & DateTime <= mdy_hms("03-06-2025 18:00:00")),) |> 
  filter(!Month %in% c("Feb","Oct","Nov"),
         !Campus == "CSUSM",
         #More known sunning of shade logger only
         !(Campus == "Whittier" & Site == "On" &
           DateTime >= ymd_hms("2025-06-01 00:00:00") &
           DateTime <= ymd_hms("2025-08-07 19:00:00")),
         !(Campus == "Whittier" & Site == "On" &
           DateTime >= ymd_hms("2025-09-11 12:30:00")),
         #!(Campus == "Pepperdine" & Site == "On" & DateTime > as.POSIXct("2025-08-17 00:00:00"))
         ) |> 
  left_join(
    select(Temp_All, !c("Sun", "Shade", "Time", "Time_sec", "Season")), 
            by = c("Campus", "DateTime", "Site", "Month", "MonthDayYear")) |> 
  select(!c("Temp", "VPD")) |> 
  mutate(es = (.611 * (exp((17.502 * Ambient )/(Ambient + 240.97)))),
         ea = es * (RH/100),
         VPD = es - ea)
```

```{r calibrate-filter-prepare}
      Campus == "Scripps" & Site == "On" & Location == "Shade"
```

```{r filter-prepare}
#SM_HourlyAvgsLong <- SM_All |>
SM_HourlyAvgsLong <-SM_All_PrecCalib |>
# SM_HourlyAvgsLong <- NoCali_Test |> 
  filter(!(Campus == "Pepperdine" & Site == "On" & Location == "Sun" & 
           DateTime > as.POSIXct("2025-09-12 08:00:00", tz = "UTC")),
        #!(Campus == "Whittier" & Site == "On" & Location == "Shade" & DateTime > as.POSIXct("2025-04-14 06:00:00") & DateTime < as.POSIXct("2025-04-26 03:00:00"))
         !(Campus =="Whittier" & Site == "On" & Location == "Sun" & 
             DateTime > as.POSIXct("2025-09-05 08:00:00") & 
             DateTime < as.POSIXct("2025-09-09 00:00:00"))) |> 
  
  #NOTE: comment out or in these lines for nighttime or daytime
  #Night:
  #filter(Time >= hms("20:00:00") | Time <= hms("06:30:00")) |>
  #Day:
  #filter(Time <= hms("20:00:00") & Time >= hms("06:30:00")) |>
    
  group_by(Time, Site, Campus, Month, Location) |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(SM, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(SM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(SM)),
    se   = sd(SM, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(SM))),
    cv   = sd(SM, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(SM, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop_last") |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(n >= 3)
#!(Campus == "Cal Poly" & Month == "Mar")

VPD_HourlyAvgsLong <- VPD_All |> 
  group_by(Time, Site, Campus, Month) |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    n    = sum(!is.na(VPD)),
    se   = sd(VPD, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(VPD))),
    cv   = sd(VPD, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop_last") |>
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(n >= 3)


LM_SM_HourlyAvgsLong <- SM_HourlyAvgsLong |> 
  mutate(Time = as.numeric(Time)/3600,
         Site = factor(Site),
         Campus = factor(Campus),
         Location = factor(Location),
         Month = factor(Month, levels = month.abb[3:9]))

LM_VPD_HourlyAvgsLong <- VPD_HourlyAvgsLong |> 
  mutate(Time = as.numeric(Time)/3600,
         Site = factor(Site),
         Campus = factor(Campus),
         Month = factor(Month, levels = month.abb[3:9]))

LM_SM_Sun_df <- LM_SM_HourlyAvgsLong |> 
  filter(Location == "Sun", Campus != "UCLA")

LM_SM_Shade_df <- LM_SM_HourlyAvgsLong |> 
  filter(Location == "Shade", Campus != "UCLA")
  
SM_Sun_transformed <- LM_SM_HourlyAvgsLong |>
  filter(Location == "Sun") |>
  mutate(mean_transformed = mean - min(mean, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.001)

SM_Shade_transformed <- LM_SM_HourlyAvgsLong |>
  filter(Location == "Shade") |>
  mutate(mean_transformed = mean - min(mean, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.001)
```

##SM Models
```{r models}
lm_SM_Sun <- lmer(mean ~ Site * Month +
                            poly(Time,2) + 
                    #Time +
                    (1|Campus) + 
                    (1|Site:Campus) +
                    (1|Month:Site:Campus)
                  , 
                  REML = FALSE,
                  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                  data = LM_SM_Sun_df)

lm_SM_Shade <- lmer(mean ~ Site * Month + poly(Time,2) +
                      #Time +
                    (1|Campus) + 
                    (1|Site:Campus) +
                   (1|Month:Site:Campus)
                  , 
                  REML = FALSE, 
                  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
                  data = LM_SM_Shade_df)
```

```{r graphs}
okabe_ito <- c(
  "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7")

SM_Graph <- SM_HourlyAvgsLong |>
  mutate(
    Month_num = match(as.character(Month), month.abb),
    Time_hr = time_length(Time, "hours"),
    grey_color = if_else(Site == "On", "grey60", "grey75"))

# Reference line: average across campuses
# SM_Graph_Ref <- SM_Graph |>
#   group_by(Site, Month, Time_hr) |>
#   summarise(
#     mean_ref = mean(mean, na.rm = TRUE),
#     .groups = "drop") |> 
#   mutate(Site_color = if_else(Site == "On", okabe_ito[2], okabe_ito[1]))

pred_SM_Sun <- emmeans(lm_SM_Sun, ~ Site | Month * Time, 
                       at = list(Time = seq(0, 23, by = .5))) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(Time_hr = Time,
         Site = factor(Site, levels = c("On", "Off")),
         Location = "Sun")

pred_SM_Shade <- emmeans(lm_SM_Shade, ~ Site | Month * Time, 
                       at = list(Time = seq(0, 23, by = .5))) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(Time_hr = Time,
         Site = factor(Site, levels = c("On", "Off")),
         Location = "Shade")

pred_SM <- pred_SM_Sun |> 
  full_join(pred_SM_Shade, 
            by = c("Site", "Month", "Time", "emmean", "SE", "df", "asymp.LCL", "asymp.UCL", "Time_hr", "Location")) |> 
  mutate(Site_color = if_else(Site == "On", okabe_ito[2], okabe_ito[1])) |> 
  arrange(Location, Month, Site, Time)

ggplot() +
  # campuses (grey)
  geom_line(data = SM_Graph,
            aes(x = Time_hr, y = mean, group = interaction(Campus, Site), color = grey_color, linetype = grey_color),
            alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1, show.legend = F) +
  # geom_point(data = SM_Graph, 
  #            aes(x = Time_hr, y = mean, group = interaction(Campus, Site)),
  #            color = "grey70", alpha = 0.6) +
  # reference line (campus-averaged)
  geom_ribbon(data = pred_SM,
              aes(x = Time, ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL, 
                  fill = Site_color, group = Site
              ), alpha = .25)+
  scale_fill_identity(name = "Site",
                      breaks = okabe_ito[c(2, 1)])+
  geom_line(
    data = pred_SM,
    aes(x = Time, y = emmean, color = Site_color, group = interaction(Location, Month, Site)
        #group = Site
        ),
    linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_identity(
    name = "Site",
    breaks = okabe_ito[c(2,1)],
    labels = c("Urban", "Non-urban"),
    guide = "legend") +
  facet_grid(Location ~ Month) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito[c(2,1)],
  #                    breaks = c("On", "Off"),
  #                    labels = c(
  #                      "On"  = "Urban",
  #                      "Off" = "Non-urban")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time of Day",
    breaks = seq(2, 20, 6)) +
  labs(y = expression("Soil Moisture (" * m^3 / m^3 * ")"),
       color = "Site") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18))
```


```{r other}
#chat-provided fix
mod_sun <- lmer(
  mean ~ Site * Month + poly(Time, 2) + (1 | Campus),
  data = SM_model_dat |> filter(Location == "Sun"))

mod_shade <- lmer(
  mean ~ Site * Month + poly(Time, 2) + (1 | Campus),
  data = SM_model_dat |> filter(Location == "Shade"))

SM_model_dat <- SM_HourlyAvgsLong |>
  filter(Campus != "CSUSM") |>
  mutate(
    Time = as.numeric(Time)/360,
    Month = factor(Month, levels = month.abb[3:9]),   # Mar-Sep
    Site = factor(Site),
    Location = factor(Location),
    Campus = factor(Campus))

pred_campus_sun <- expand_grid(
  Time = sort(unique(SM_model_dat$Time)),
  Site = levels(SM_model_dat$Site),
  Month = levels(SM_model_dat$Month),
  Campus = levels(SM_model_dat$Campus)) |>
  mutate(
    fit = predict(mod_sun, newdata = ., re.form = NULL),
    Location = "Sun")
pred_campus_shade <- expand_grid(
  Time = sort(unique(SM_model_dat$Time)),
  Site = levels(SM_model_dat$Site),
  Month = levels(SM_model_dat$Month),
  Campus = levels(SM_model_dat$Campus)) |>
  mutate(
    fit = predict(mod_shade, newdata = ., re.form = NULL),
    Location = "Shade")
pred_campus <- bind_rows(pred_campus_sun, pred_campus_shade)

pred_ref_sun <- expand_grid(
  Time = sort(unique(SM_model_dat$Time)),
  Site = levels(SM_model_dat$Site),
  Month = levels(SM_model_dat$Month)) |>
  mutate(
    fit = predict(mod_sun, newdata = ., re.form = NA),
    Location = "Sun")
pred_ref_shade <- expand_grid(
  Time = sort(unique(SM_model_dat$Time)),
  Site = levels(SM_model_dat$Site),
  Month = levels(SM_model_dat$Month)) |>
  mutate(
    fit = predict(mod_shade, newdata = ., re.form = NA),
    Location = "Shade")
pred_ref <- bind_rows(pred_ref_sun, pred_ref_shade)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_campus |> filter(Site == "On"),
    aes(x = Time, y = fit, group = Campus),
    color = "grey60",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.6,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_campus |> filter(Site == "Off"),
    aes(x = Time, y = fit, group = Campus),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.6,
    linetype = "dashed",
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_ref,
    aes(x = Time, y = fit, color = Site),
    linewidth = 1.4) +
  facet_grid(Location ~ Month) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Site",
    values = c(
      "On" = okabe_ito[2],
      "Off" = okabe_ito[1]),
    labels = c(
      "On" = "Urban",
      "Off" = "Non-urban")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time of Day",
    breaks = seq(0, 240, 60),
    labels = c("0", "6", "12", "18", "24")) +
  labs(y = expression("Soil Moisture (" * m^3 / m^3 * ")")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18))

```
